summary: Custom objective: a { type, value } pair (both required when custom is used).
constraints: Both type and value required when custom is present.
value domain depends on type (see custom.value).
businessRules: custom defines: The custom parameter is used to define special objectives apart from the simpler travel cost minimization objectives.
Must stay consistent with: options.objective.custom.type, options.objective.custom.value. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Required field. Missing causes HTTP 400 validation error.
validationRules: custom with only type or only value -> 400.
